Figure 7: Illustration of Theorem 4.6. Top: input tensors to the TOM for matrix multiplication; modes are color-coded. Bottom: operands are broadcasted (dotted arrows) according to the coupling structure and then merged to create a 2-regular hyper-tensor (bottom right).
